summary: Flyte Aviation, Inc. (formerly Catheter Precision) filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, disclosing a name change and a 1-for-10 reverse stock split, effective 12:01 a.m. ET that day. The common stock began trading on NYSE American under ticker VJET with new CUSIP 74933X807. Post-split, approximately 2,101,987 shares are outstanding, subject to cash-out of fractional shares. A press release launched the aviation charter business, citing an $11.6 billion US private jet charter market. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. Watch for trading liquidity, charter platform execution, and integration risks.
